prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production game animation sprite sheet.
Input image 1 is a CHARACTER APPEARANCE reference only; replace its layout entirely. Generate one transparent PNG with EXACTLY SIX COLUMNS and SIX ROWS, 36 full body sprites. Canvas square, ideally 1536 x 1536, uniform square cells. No text, borders, grid, background or ground shadows.
Each row is ONE consistent medieval realistic character in SIX DIFFERENT successive poses of a WALK-IN-PLACE loop, facing RIGHT in the same three-quarter camera angle throughout. All six figures in a row MUST be same character, costume, proportions and equipment. Make leg and arm pose changes very clear; this must be an animation sheet, not six repeated stills.
Row 1: gray hooded leather swordsman with a small amber lantern, matching reference top-left character.
Row 2: ivory hooded priest with long robe and cross staff, matching reference second character.
Row 3: armored knight with shield and sword, matching reference third character.
Row 4: olive hooded adventurer with bow and quiver, matching reference fourth character.
Row 5: rust-red hooded raider with knife, matching reference second-row first character.
Row 6: olive-coated merchant with leather satchel and cap, matching reference second-row second character.
In EACH row, columns are chronological walk cycle: 1 right leg forward/left leg back contact; 2 weight lowering right planted foot rear heel lifted; 3 left bent knee passing forward right leg supporting; 4 left leg forward/right leg back contact; 5 weight lowering left planted foot right heel lifted; 6 right bent knee passing forward left leg supporting. Counter-swing arms, subtle robe and cloak follow-through; feet clearly step, knees bend. Both hands keep their equipment; no extra arms or gear changes.
Registration is essential: exactly aligned columns and rows with transparent gutters, all silhouettes wholly INSIDE their own cells. For every cell the pelvis root is at x=50%, head is near y=12%, lowest grounded boot at y=88%; constant anatomical body height and root position across a row. Silhouette fits within x=8%-92% and y=8%-92%. No cropped weapons, hair, feet or cloak. No travelling across the sheet, no rotations between frames, no alternate front/back views. Avoid motion blur, effects, glow spill and detached pixels. Soft consistent studio light, realistic weathered medieval materials, natural human anatomy matching reference; transparent background with real alpha.

Edit the supplied six-column six-row sprite animation sheet for production use. Preserve all six character designs, realistic materials, right-facing camera, row order and SIX columns by SIX rows exactly. Two specific corrections:
1) EVERY cell must have broad transparent gutters. Use an EXACT uniform square grid. Each figure fits completely inside x=12%..88%, y=18%..84% OF ITS OWN CELL. Center pelvis at cell x=50%; grounded boot soles exactly at cell y=84%. No character, staff, bow, sword, lantern or cloak touches any cell boundary. Keep at least 12% transparent padding on all four sides. Constant body scale within each row. Actual transparent background alpha, no grid or shadows, no text.
2) Make this a REAL six-pose walk cycle, not nearly duplicate right-leg-forward pictures. In ALL SIX ROWS: column1 right knee forward left leg stretched BACK; column2 RIGHT foot planted, LEFT knee distinctly LIFTED and flexed at 90 degrees; column3 LEFT knee extends forward, right heel trails; column4 LEFT leg clearly forward and RIGHT leg stretches BACK (reverse of col1); column5 LEFT foot planted, RIGHT knee distinctly LIFTED and flexed; column6 RIGHT knee extends forward, left heel trails. Feet remain visible beneath robes. Arms and held equipment counter-swing distinctly between opposing steps without changing gear. Show different knee bends, forward/back feet and elbow angles, but no rotations or translation of body root. Heads stay at same height except very subtle gait motion.
Everything else unchanged. 36 separate full-body figures on transparent background, no additional figures.

Create a transparent RPG animation atlas. The first reference gives SIX HUMAN CHARACTER IDENTITIES and their look only; the second gives their six walking poses.
Critical visible change from the second reference: SHRINK ALL FIGURES TO 60% OF THEIR CURRENT SIZE within the same atlas, preserving their internal proportions. There must be very LARGE EMPTY TRANSPARENT GAPS around every complete character, like isolated small miniatures. The previous arrangement was too tightly packed. This new atlas must be visibly much less crowded.
Exact grid: SIX columns and SIX rows. 36 separate miniatures. Square 1536x1536 canvas. Each cell is256x256. The whole figure including staff, sword and bow fits inside the central154x154 area of its cell, leaving51pixels of transparent space on EACH side. In every cell midpoint between planted feet is x128,y205. Highest head/staff y51 or lower. Nobody crosses cell boundaries. All frames in a row equal body scale. NO touching between rows or columns! No gridlines or cell labels.
Row1 grayhooded leatherplayer withsword andamberlantern. Row2 ivoryhoodedpriest withcrossstaff. Row3 platedknight withshieldandsword. Row4 olivehoodedarcher withbowandquiver. Row5 rust-redhoodedraiderwithknife. Row6 olivecoatmerchant withsatchelandcap.
All face screenRIGHT fixedthree-quarterview. Six consecutive DISTINCT WALK cycle phases across EACH row: rightfootforward heelcontact; rightfootplanted kneecompressed leftfootlifting; leftknee passingrightsupportleg; LEFTfootforward heelcontact; leftfootplanted kneecompressed RIGHTfootlifting; rightkneepassingleftsupportleg. Arms counter-swing, cloakfollows. Clearly alternatewhichlegisforward, bendkneesnoticeably. Samebodyheightandrootposition, no duplicatedposes, nofloating, noturning.
Match originalmaterialtextures andrealisticanatomy; samecharacterperrow. PURE TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND ALPHA, no shadows,floor,effects,text,numbers,border,checkerboard. Only36completesmallfullycontainedanimatedhumanspriteswithhugetransparentpadding.
